It can be used to connect pipelines that are different materials such as metal, cast iron and vitrified clay pipes.Including a step-moulded elastomeric sleeve with differing diameters at each end, this adaptor coupling is fitted with two stainless steel clamping bands that offer an effective method for joining pipes that have various outer diameters. This ensures it is cost-effective, eliminating potential bush requirements. It is also suitable for connecting all new and traditional pipe systems including structural walled plastic pipes.Features & Benefits: Fernco Rubber Flexible Drainage Adaptor CouplingRange of diameters availableHigh-performance sealing qualitiesEradicates the need for grouting in most applicationsShear band ensures pipe alignment and joint flexibilityComplies with WIS 4-41-01 for all public sewers and sewers for adoptionReduces excavation workStainless steel shear band for excellent resistance to shear forces and heavy loadsDurable design with a reliable seal50-year manufacturer’s guaranteeSpecial ranges of adaptor couplings integrate an extra wide clamping band at one end and are also available for ribbed pipe systems. The clamping band fastens against two or more external ribs on the plastic ribbed pipe to ensure a high-performance seal regardless of the coupling movement or position.

product.name: Fernco Puddle Flange for Drain Pipes
product.description: Formerly Flexseal, Fernco Puddle Flanges serve the purpose of sealing the area around pipes that pass through concrete structures like tanks, manhole chambers, shafts, floor slabs and basements. Manufactured from sturdy EPDM, these reliable flanges are typically installed during the construction phase.When pipes pass through concrete, they do not bond to the concrete, creating a potential route for water to flow along the external surface of the pipe. However, Fernco Puddle Flanges act as a barrier, preventing water penetration in such situations. The flange is clamped onto the pipe, obstructing this direct water route. During the pouring process, the seal body is compressed, and if the concrete shrinks during curing, the rubber in the flange relaxes and maintains a seal, preventing any water flow along this path.Features & Benefits: Fernco Puddle Flange for Drain PipesHighly versatile, cost-effective solution for sealing pipes which pass through concreteSuitable for use in walls, floors and ceilingsGood chemical resistanceQuick & easy to installAvailable in a wide range of sizes

product.name: Fernco HDPE Penstock Valve Extension Spindle Set
product.description: Effortlessly control penstock valves with Fernco's Telescopic HDPE Penstock Valve Extension Spindle Set. Ideal for below-ground or pit installations, these sets offer remote operation. Choose from a range of sizes to match your specific needs for seamless water flow management.To install your extension spindle, start by removing the BS cap. Then, place the extension spindle over the penstock spindle. Position the upper bracket 150mm below the deck or the top of the spindle extension. Mark the mounting holes for the brackets to ensure the extension spindle is in the correct position. Remove the spindle extension and install the brackets as required. Finally, reinstall the spindle extension and adjust the bracket positions as needed to ensure proper alignment.Features & Benefits: Fernco HDPE Penstock Valve Extension Spindle SetAllows remote valve control of your penstockDesigned for below-ground or pit installationsVarious sizes available to suit specific requirementsSimplifies water flow managementQuick and easy installation

product.name: Clearwater Shallow Dig Cesspool
product.description:
Clearwater shallow dig cesspools are a great option for off-mains buildings where the surrounding area means it’s not possible to install a soakaway to go hand in hand with a septic tank or sewage treatment plant. Clearwater cesspools are for use in situations where there is a high winter water table, where the area of installation is a protected zone or if the soil it will be installed in to is the wrong type to allow a drainage field to be installed.
These shallow dig cesspools have 1 inlet and a lid, which can be removed for the contents to be pumped out by a specialist operator. As a total containment tank, these shallow dig cesspools from Clearwater can be used for the storage of surface water, animal waste, as rainwater harvesting reservoirs and as firefighting reservoirs in areas where there are no mains connections. This cesspool cannot be used for the storage of drinking water.
By opting for this Clearwater shallow dig cesspool labour costs and installation time is minimised as less ground needs to be excavated. Manufactured from chemically resistant and watertight GRP, on dry sites these cesspools can be backfilled with pea shingles with no concerns over durability or stability on the cesspool.
Please note: For collecting and storing the effluence of a domestic, commercial or industrial building, the smallest capacity cesspool that must be used, to comply with building regulations, is 18000 litres.

product.name: Clearwater Alpha Spherical Onion Septic Tank with A15 Lid
product.description:
The Clearwater Alpha range of Septic Tanks only provides settlement for sewage solids. The liquid overflow requires further biological treatment in a suitably designed, correctly situated drainage field. This septic tank from Clearwater comes with an A15 load class lid.

Made from composite GRP - strong, light, chemically resistant and watertight
Press moulded shape provides wide, squat, form which makes the tank easy to install and handle
Stable base for storage
Shackles are provided to aid lifting and positioning within the excavation
All unit volumes are designed in accordance with the recommendations given in BS 6297:1983
The new manufacturing process minimises styrene emissions and reduces waste - all the better for our environment

product.name: Clearwater Shallow Dig Septic Tank
product.description:
Clearwater shallow dig septic tanks are the perfect choice for when sewage treatment plants, which discharge cleaned effluent into the ground, are not suitable. Throughout the Clearwater septic tank range, this is the highest capacity tank and it can store the effluent of up to 47 people, perfect for off-mains domestic properties, holiday homes and static caravans.
To reduce costs and installation time this septic tank is shallow dig, meaning you need to excavate less of the ground where it will be installed. Save on labour costs even more on dry sites too as this septic tank can be backfilled with pea shingles. There’s no need to worry about the durability of this septic tank with pea shingles or concrete backfill as it’s manufactured from strong, chemically resistant and watertight GRP.
99.7% efficient and approved to EN12566-1, these septic tanks are the perfect upgrade from traditional cesspools as they tend to last longer, increase hygiene and have improved efficiency in the treatment of waste.

product.name: Freefoam Square Edge uPVC Fascia Board Corner
product.description: This square leg, external corner complements the Freefoam uPVC fascia range, providing a professional finish to your roofline project, seamlessly integrating with your fascia boards and the rest of your roofline system. The coloured fascia corners are supported by Freefoam’s innovative Colormax technology to provide colourfastness, colour matching and colour variety.Features & Benefits: Freefoam Square Edge uPVC Fascia Board CornerTested fire-resistant properties  Lead-free environmentally friendly solution  Home improvement solution with low maintenance requirements  Compatible with the 10mm, 18mm and 25mm uPVC square leg fascia boards  Resistant to discolouration with a 10-year guarantee for the coloured corner and a 20-year guarantee for the white corner  UV and air pollution resistant  Made from PVC-UE foam core and uPVC solid top coating  Complies with relevant BS and European standardsThe woodgrain corners are supported by market-leading Renolit EXOFOL MX foil with incorporated Solar Shield Technology (SST). This built-in sun reflection minimalizes profile temperature and expansion by reducing heat absorption. Lightweight and easy to handle, this fascia corner requires minimal maintenance once installed.

The plastic headed nails are produced from A4 marine grade stainless steel and are available in a wide range of colours to match all Freefoam colours and woodgrain finishes.
Plastops is a range of fixings which come in a variety of sizes and colours to match Freefoam’s fascia, soffit and cladding systems.
PVC roofline and rainwater products are fixed in place using colour matched plastic-headed pins and nails that blend into the product being installed and ensure a professional installation.
Plastops fixings are produced from A4 marine grade stainless steel to eliminate the risk of rust and discolouration, designed for high shock absorption to ensure the tops remain in place during fixing and ringshanked for increased grip when installed.

product.name: Freefoam 10mm Square Edged Cappit uPVC Fascia Board 5m
product.description: This Cap Over uPVC fascia board is an ideal way of improving existing wood fascia boards without a full replacement when your original fascia boards do not need to be removed completely. Ideal for protecting your existing system, this square leg fascia provides a professional, clean finish with a stylish and modern appearance.Available in a variety of colours and woodgrain finishes in a range of sizes, the coloured fascia board features Freefoam patented Colormax technology while the woodgrain finishes have been produced using market-leading Renolit Exofol with built-in Solar Shield Technology (SST) to reduce heat absorption and minimalize profile temperature and expansion. With a 10-year guarantee on coloured and woodgrain finishes and 20 years for white, this fascia board has been made with extra Titanium Dioxide, protecting against UV damage meaning it looks good and lasts for longer.Features & Benefits: Freefoam 10mm Square Edged Cappit uPVC Fascia Board 5mLeak-free, fully integrated system  Resistant to air pollution and UV damage  Available in a range of colours and sizes to fit your building needs  Home improvement solution with minimal maintenance requirements  Sustainable, environmentally friendly and lead-free  Ideal for improving your fascia boards without a full replacement installation  Made with a strong PVC-UE foam core and a rigid uPVC top coating  BBA certified to 99/3585, CSTB approved to 2/16-1766 and Quality System certified to ISO9001:2015 by SGSGuaranteed not to crack, blister or warp, this fascia board has a strong PVC-UE foam ‘core’ which is protected by a top coating of rigid uPVC giving a strong, hard-wearing, smooth skin. Made using an advanced environmentally friendly, lead-free formulation, this fascia board ensures maximum protection and long life with minimal maintenance requirements.

product.description: This Doubled Ended Square Leg/Plain Fascia/Reveal Liner has been manufactured to last and is available in a range of widths with a variety of colours featuring Freefoam patented Colormax technology and woodgrain finishes produced with market-leading Renolit Exofol with built-in Solar Shield Technology, reducing heat absorption and minimalizing profile temperature and expansion.Perfect for improving existing wood fascia boards without a full replacement and completely removing the original fascia boards, this fascia board is ideal for protecting your existing fascia system and providing a professional, clean finish with a stylish and modern appearance. With a smooth, hard-wearing, strong skin, this fascia board is coated with robust uPVC and has a strong PVC-UE foam ‘core’. Made with extra Titanium Dioxide, this uPVC double-ended fascia board is protected from UV damage, so it looks good and lasts for longer, resisting discolouration with a 20-year guarantee for the white fascia board and a 10-year guarantee for the coloured fascia boards. product.name: Freeflow Half Round Plastic Gutter
product.description:
Freeflow is a range of innovative, high quality PVC-U rainwater systems that are the result of Freefoam’s culture of continuous innovation and investment in research and development. The Freeflow range has been designed to ensure both reliable, leak-free performance and quick installation. In addition, it is compatible with other rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Freeflow products come in a range of standard colours including white, black and brown.
Each rainwater system is co-extruded with a white interior and a range of exterior colours - Freefoam’s new innovative solution to the problems associated with rapid heat absorption and expansion of gutters. Widely published test results show that while a white surface exposed to sunshine can absorb heat and attain a surface temperature 10ºC or more over the air temperature, dark surfaces can rise a further 30-40ºC and exceed the softening point of the PVC. On large capacity gutters with a large surface area facing the sun, this can be a particular problem. While the interior will be exposed to sunlight as normal, its absorption of heat from the sun and subsequent expansion along its width and length will be significantly reduced, thus dramatically decreasing the probability of any associated problems.

Freeflow products come in a range of standard colours including white, black and brown.
Each rainwater system is co-extruded with a white interior and a range of exterior colours - Freefoam’s new innovative solution to the problems associated with rapid heat absorption and expansion of gutters. Widely published test results show that while a white surface exposed to sunshine can absorb heat and attain a surface temperature 10ºC or more over the air temperature, dark surfaces can rise a further 30-40ºC and exceed the softening point of the PVC. On large capacity gutters with a large surface area facing the sun, this can be a particular problem. While the interior will be exposed to sunlight as normal, its absorption of heat from the sun and subsequent expansion along its width and length will be significantly reduced, thus dramatically decreasing the probability of any associated problems.
